scope: Opt-in motion-supported contact and physics-qualified short-flight bridging against the selected exit-only policy; Metrica Sample Game 1 development only.
contact_rule: A contact needs four consecutive observed near-ball strong-control frames from the same player slot and normalized ball-velocity change of at least 0.25 within that run. It is not independently verified physical touch.
flight_rule: Carry the contact team only inside a completed, baseline-agreeing bounded bracket with observed fast far-from-both-team flight. Allow at most three consecutive linearly interpolated frames only when four observed positions on each side, no stoppage, no near player in the gap, and speed/direction/acceleration agree. Never extrapolate long missing-ball runs or infer a touch inside a gap.

initial_hard_continuity.failed_guards: Recovery-instant accuracy in clean/no-tag, clean/degraded-tag and both tagged variants of the 2s and 5s known-live gap stresses.

supported_switch_safeguard.rule: Do not override a baseline H/A switch inside the flight when its incoming team meets the pre-existing 8-of-20 strong-control transition support condition.
supported_switch_safeguard.interpretation: All 19 changed clean/no-tag frames disappear; guard passage by reproducing the baseline is not an improvement.

decision: No promotion or Game 2/3/DFL transfer: the active candidate fails recovery guards and the safeguarded candidate changes no labels, missing the unchanged +0.002 development threshold. Provider recovery events score predictions but do not validate physical touches; the working submission and CSV remain unchanged.
